title: render_widget
description: Gives a mounted widget extension its render settings, and for a data widget its data.

target.description: A generated extension in the widgets domain.

render.description: The stamped render instance: the widget instance's render object with the id the root stamps, <render type>~UUIDv5(namespace, widget id | role | render), validated with the widget instance against its own type and registered against its render type.

value_format.description: Data widget only: the widget instance's value_format.

data.description: Data widget only: the stamped and validated data instance.
